evidence.text: Which I rejected and immediately scheduled an appointment at a different express care.
As always, Natalie is on top of my care, discussing next steps, answering questions, and providing advice promptly.
I was so happy to find an appointment easily.
It was so easy to make an appointment.
One medical always gives great appointment logistics.
I called to see if they could check my son’s nose to see if he broke it, and they said they could and made me an appointment.
So glad I didn’t have to wait until Monday and hope for a same day appointment at my regular doctor.
My appointment was at 2:15.
I was nervous going into my appointment after not going to the dentist for years but they gave me the best experience.
When I made an appointment online for an urgent care visit, there were plenty of time slots open.
Very quick response, appointment and prescription.
I called and told them that I would get appointment for my wife due of coughing and the receptionist answerer and give me the appointment right away with our choice of times.
I made appointment with the lab (LabCorp) and they told me they no longer worked with Carbon Health and the order is not valid.
I waited 30 minutes only to be told their lab is closed today, even though  there was no communication about adjusted hours on the door.
I made an online appointment.
It’s so easy to make an appointment through One Medical.
Apologized for being late and was told by the receptionist (a pretty rude guy) that my appointment might be short since I was late.
Made an appointment with a Doctor that was recommended to me there 7 months in advance.
Great experience at Carbon Health Where else can you get a same day urgent care appointment?

Dear Dr. Lu, Dr. Scott and the Hope Neuro Accupuncture Rehab Team,

I just wanted to send a heartfelt thank you for helping me achieve my dream of running the Boston Marathon this past week.

Two weeks before race day, I developed debilitating hip pain that caused me to limp while walking or running. My physical therapist treated me for a pulled groin and weak hip flexors, but I still wasn’t well enough to run. Fortunately, I was referred to you—and you generously made time to evaluate me just hours before I was scheduled to board my flight to Boston. You and your team thoroughly assessed me both on the table and on the treadmill, identifying that my hip imbalance stemmed from an overly supinated foot strike and weak VMO (quadriceps) muscles. You also determined that the issue wasn’t my deep hip flexors, but rather tightness in my IT band and tenderness in my TFL. After performing dry needling and teaching me new cues to improve my running form, I left your office—for the first time during my taper period—with a renewed sense of hope and confidence that I might actually finish the marathon, something that had felt uncertain before our visit.

Thanks to your care, I ran the entire marathon without any hip or foot issues. That allowed me to fully enjoy and connect with the incredible Boston crowd, who lifted me up and carried me through all 26.2 miles. It truly felt like one big, unforgettable celebration — and I am so grateful you helped make that experience possible.
